requirements.text: The system shall ensure accurate recording of financial transactions to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 7 years and log user access.
The system shall implement tiered error handling prioritizing critical transactions while ensuring compliance checks.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms that optimize performance without compromising data integrity.
The system shall support dual logging for critical and non-critical transactions with role-based access control.
The system shall integrate performance monitoring tools to dynamically adjust caching strategies based on energy consumption.
The system shall develop a sustainability assessment framework to evaluate the environmental impact of all processes.
The system shall comply with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
